review.assessment: This change introduces a stubbed `RingBuffer<T>` that stores no actual data (only a `_marker` phantom) and leaves every public method as an explicit panic via `unimplemented!()`. It completely fails to provide the required backing storage, head/tail indices, or FIFO overwrite logic specified by the task.

findings.actual: Calls to any RingBuffer method immediately panic with 'not yet implemented' because no struct fields hold data and no methods contain logic.
findings.expected: Methods execute without panicking, correctly maintaining a fixed-capacity queue where pushes overwrite the oldest items and `to_vec()` returns contents from oldest to newest.
